value.rationale: The result completely classifies the most numerous isolated Brill--Noether problem at every fixed genus, reducing a family of rank/degree enumerative problems to the divisor of \(g\) closest to \(\sqrt g\), with Serre duality explaining all ties. This is a natural structural extremal statement about a classical enumerative invariant, not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere numerical recomputation.
